assumptionsNote: Per-interaction network-call profile of cx-client-data-sidebar 3.9.0 (v2.9.2/cx-client-data-sidebar-v2.9.0), extracted from source 2026-08-16. Pilot live config assumed: DEMO_MODE=false, direct mode (no broker), shared Asana PAT + Slack bot token + Guru auth via Zendesk secure proxy, guru_suggest_tags/subject OFF, triage_field_map blank, aht_endpoint blank, asana_status_buttons OFF. Fractional n = expected value folding a probability into a count (e.g. 0.6 chance a ticket has linked tasks x 1.8 tasks = 1.08). Fleet-size assumptions marked ASSUMED below; re-run with overrides to test sensitivity.
